body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Sprite has presented its new 5.1-channel Bluetooth home theater speaker ''SAM-2114DW''.
It employs Dolby stereo, optical terminal which enables to connect various home entertainment devices like media center pc or DVD player.

In general, TV and DVD player are connected with a cable. But, this product provides a separate RGB component terminal in the main body, which enables you to control sound through GUI (graphic user interface).

By employing Sprite proprietary technology in the process of receiving signal in the mode of Bluetooth, this model increases compression rate and thus minimizes the loss of data. It also helps to block external interruption like noise. It is possible to send and receive signals within 40m.
The company is going to unveil its Bluetooth technology with 40-inch LCD TV, 42-inch PDP TV at CES 2006. It also plans to release 7.1-channel model.
